# Overview {#sec-pre-course}

```{r}
#| include: false

library(downlit)
```

In order to participate in this course, you must complete everything in this
section and finish with **completing the [survey](/pre-course/survey.qmd)** at
the end. These tasks are meant to provide everyone with the necessary setup and
a shared foundation for the course.

Depending on your prior knowledge and skills, these tasks could take between
**TIME hrs to finish**, so we suggest planning some time to complete them. While
many of the tasks are mostly readings, they are important in making sure you get
the most out of the course.

## Summary of tasks

Here's a quick overview of the tasks you need to do. Specific details about them
are found as you work through the tasks. Most of the time spent on the tasks is
on the reading tasks. We include these reading tasks to have you as aware and as
well-prepared as we can before the course, so that we have a smoother start and
so that you benefit more from the improved learning from the earlier and
repeated exposure.

If you haven't already, go through the course overview section, including the
[Syllabus](/overview/syllabus.qmd) and [Learning
design](/overview/learning-design.qmd) to get an overview of what this course
contains and the learning design behind the course material.

After that, please go through the the pre-course tasks designed to establish a
shared foundation for the start of the course. This includes:

1. Read the learning objectives in the
   [Studieordning](https://moduler.aau.dk/course/2024-2025/MEDMS24B5_1).
2. Read about how to read this website in @sec-reading-website (below on this
   page).
3. Do some reading tasks in @sec-pre-reading.
4. Install the necessary programs and the right versions of those programs in
   @sec-install-programs. As mentioned in the callout block above, depending on
   your institution, this task can take the **longest amount of time** because
   you have to contact your IT to install these packages.
5. Read about and navigate R and RStudio in @sec-r-and-rstudio.
6. Install necessary R packages in @sec-installing-r-packages. This may be a bit
   technical for you, so start early.
7. Read through the Code of Conduct in @sec-code-of-conduct.
8. Complete the pre-course [survey](survey.qmd) in @sec-survey. This survey is
   pretty quick, maybe \~10 minutes. There will be some bits from the tasks that
   you will need to paste into this survey.

In general, these pre-course tasks are meant to help prepare you for the course
and make sure everything is setup properly so the first session runs smoothly.
While most of these pre-course tasks are meant to prepare you for the course,
some of them are also designed for learning purposes

::: {.hidden}
to enable you to:

{{< include /includes/objectives/_pre-course.qmd >}}
:::
